question: How does abstaining from food by day affect age and death?
premises: The practice involves non-eating by day
Age and death are the conditions faced
The practice leads to going beyond them
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply overcoming or passing beyond death.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
